339-677-7060-8227.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
339-677-7060-8227.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Loot by sacrificing Jegantha, giving Loot -2/-0 until end of turn
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

640-2393-4279--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
640-2393-4279--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Dross Harvester, Sifter of Skulls and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Dross Harvester trigger, causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Sifter of Skulls ability, creating a 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Dross Harvester triggers, causing you to gain 2 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

2174-2645-3430-3756.easyPrerequisites: Juniper Order Druid doesn't have summoning sickness.
2174-2645-3430-3756.description:
Activate Izzet Boilerworks by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}{R}{R}{R} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Juniper Order Druid by tapping it, untapping Izzet Boilerworks
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Juniper Order Druid.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

333-2292-8207.easyPrerequisites: Ferocity of the Hunt attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
333-2292-8207.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Shepherd of the Cosmos.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos dies, Ferocity of the Hunt triggers, returning Shepherd of the Cosmos from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Ferocity of the Hunt from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-1417-3249-6006--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-1417-3249-6006--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Enduring Vitality by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Bridge from Below triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

141-3899-7166.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-3899-7166.description:
Cast Dose of Dawnglow by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Dose of Dawnglow.
Holding priority, activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Naru Meha, putting a charge counter on Spawning Pit.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Dose of Dawnglow
Resolve the Dose of Dawnglow copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

225-2557-3129-4365-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers eight times
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a New Planet.
Repeat from step 3 for the remaining triggers.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

2073-2438-6808-7878.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is 12 or less.
2073-2438-6808-7878.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning The Last Ride from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When The Last Ride enters, Kolodin triggers, causing The Last Ride to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing The Last Ride.
When The Last Ride dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

1594-4268-4399-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Helm of Awakening.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Kor Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Kor Celebrant trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Kor Celebrant trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
1594-4268-4399-4770.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

2447-3259-6968.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2447-3259-6968.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Infestation Expert // Infested Werewolf as attackers.
Infestation Expert // Infested Werewolf triggers, creating at least one creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

4390-5078-6595-6757-7633.easyPrerequisites: You control two other untapped artifacts.
4390-5078-6595-6757-7633.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Activate Meria's second ability by tapping two artifacts, exiling Sensei's Divining Top with the ability to play it until end of turn.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from exile by paying {0} due to Lyse Hext.
Lyse Hext's prowess ability and Ravenous Robots triggers, creating a 1/1 Robot artifact creature token and giving Lyse Hext +1/+1 until end of turn.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Weapons Manufacturing triggers, creating a Munitions token.
Repeat.

2713-4866-6822-7426.easyPrerequisites: There's a removable +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
2713-4866-6822-7426.description:
Activate Sage of Fables by paying {1} due to Zirda and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, causing you to draw a card.
Lyla triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta triggers, adding {1}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with five or more +1/+1 counters on it and without summoning sickness

1494-4153-7347.description:
Activate Solarion by tapping it, doubling the number of +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Resourceful Defense by paying {4}{W}, moving five +1/+1 counters from Solarion onto Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2034-2700-6972.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Arcbound Shikari.
When Arcbound Shikari dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Shikari's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Shikari from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Repeat.

3110-3532-5078-6768.notablePrerequisites: Uthros Research Craft has at least 12 charge counters on it.
3110-3532-5078-6768.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Diving Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a charge counter from Uthros Research Craft.
Uthros Research Craft triggers, putting a charge counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

803-2366-4050-6879.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
803-2366-4050-6879.description:
Play Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Arcane Adaptation, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Activate Dryad Arbor by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Abor dies, Haru triggers, returning Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

147-5147-6819.description:
Cast Vincent's Limit Break by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Vincent's Limit Break, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Vincent's Limit Break.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Goblin Bombardment abilities from step 5.

2167-2757-5702-6973.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
You control a basic Forest.
2167-2757-5702-6973.description:
Play a land.
When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Mutable Explorer.
When the Mutable Explorer token enters, it trigger.
Holding priority, activate Earthcraft by tapping the Mutable Explorer token, untapping a basic Forest.
Activate the Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Mutable Explorer trigger, creating a Mutavault land token that enters tapped.
When the Mutavault token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers.
Holding priority, activate Squandered Resources by sacrificing the Mutavault token, adding {C}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Mutable Explorer.
Repeat from step 3.

1003-2173-5220-5330.description:
Activate Atog by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker
When Phyrexian Walker dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Atog ability.
Cast Phyrexian Walker from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

2457-3000-5794-6753.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect and two 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Activate Baylen's first ability twice by tapping the Squirrel and Insect tokens, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

313-1777-4863.description:
Cast Burnt Offering by paying {B} and sacrificing Revolutionist, adding {B}{B} and then an amount of additional {B} and/or {R} equal to its mana value minus 2.
Cast Corpse Dance with buyback by paying {4}{B}, returning Revolutionist from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Revolutionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Burnt Offering from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1965-2018-4053.description:
Cast Omarthis by paying {0}.
Omarthis enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Omarthis from your graveyard to the battlefield without a flying counter due to Solemnity.
Repeat from step 2.
1965-2018-4053.notes: The combo creates a mandatory infinite loop that will cause the game to end in a draw if it isn't interacted with.

275-2034-2267-6718.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Extractor Demon triggers, causing you to mill two cards if your graveyard is empty, or causing an opponent to mill two cards otherwise.
If your library is empty, activate Transplant Theorist by paying {2}, putting a card from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Tormod triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Repeat.
275-2034-2267-6718.notes: The combo will grant you an amount of {C} equal to the number of cards in your library, as you do not need to do step 3 as long as your library has cards in it. You can instead also target an opponent in step 2 if your graveyard is not empty.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

2511-4550-5567-6254--112.easyPrerequisites: You have two or more cards in hand.
2511-4550-5567-6254--112.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the Zombie, whose power should have been altered from its base power.
When the Zombie dies, Jason Bright triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

413-1737-3621-4853.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {8} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Su-Chi Cave Guard.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping itself.
Activate Blasting Station by sacrificing Su-Chi Cave Guard and tapping it.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, Su-Chi Cave Guard and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the Su-Chi Cave Guard trigger, adding eight {C}.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Prototype Portal.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

290-3767-3918-5929.easyPrerequisites: Trazyn the Infinite does not have summoning sickness.
290-3767-3918-5929.notablePrerequisites: Leyline of Transformation on the battlefield with "Sliver" chosen.
290-3767-3918-5929.description:
Activate Trazyn using Dreamstone Hedron's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1018-1987-4125-4276.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
1018-1987-4125-4276.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Shipwreck Dowser and Skullwinder.
When Shipwreck Dowser and Skullwinder enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1018-1987-4125-4276.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

1785-3562-5003.notablePrerequisites:
Soldevi Adnate does not have summoning sickness.
Nim Deathmantle attached to Sky Hussar.
1785-3562-5003.description:
Activate Soldevi Adnate by tapping it and sacrificing Sky Hussar, adding an amount of {B} equal to Sky Hussar's mana value.
When Sky Hussar dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Sky Hussar from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Sky Hussar enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat.

2160-2743-5361.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least three opponents.
Auton Soldier does not have summoning sickness.
2160-2743-5361.description:
Attack with Auton Soldier.
Auton Soldier's myriad ability triggers, creating two token copies of Biovisionary that are tapped and attacking.
At the end of combat, the two Biovisionary tokens' sacrifice triggers from the myriad ability are put on the stack.
Holding priority, activate Sundial of the Infinite by paying {1} and tapping it, exiling the sacrifice triggers and ending the turn.
At the beginning of the next player's end step, each copy of Biovisionary triggers, causing you to win the game.

275-1799-5296.manaNeeded: {4} minus {1} for each +1/+1 counter on Workhorse
275-1799-5296.description:
Activate Workhorse by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}.
Repeat step 1 until Workhorse dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Activate Transplant Theorist by paying {2}, putting Workhorse from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Workhorse from the bottom of your library into your graveyard, and then putting it onto the battlefield with four +1/+1 counters on it due to its static effect.
Repeat.

2660-2707-5733.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Rogue that cannot be blocked by an opponent and that does not have summoning sickness.
2660-2707-5733.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using a Rogue.
Cast Notorious Throng for its prowl cost by paying {5}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and creating a number of 1/1 Faerie Rogue creature tokens.
Notorious Throng is put on the bottom of your library instead of into your graveyard due to Wheel of Sun and Moon.
Move to your extra turn, drawing Notorious Throng from the bottom of your library during your draw step due to River Song.
Repeat.

1823-2488-2968.notablePrerequisites: An opponent controls at least one creature.
1823-2488-2968.description:
Cast Apex Altisaur by paying {7}{G}{G}.
When Apex Altisaur enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers.
Holding priority, cast Ajani's Presence by paying {2}{W}{W}, giving Apex Altisaur and any creature an opponent controls +1/+1 and indestructible until end of turn.
Resolve the Apex Altisaur trigger, causing Apex Altisaur to fight the indestructible creature the opponent controls.
Apex Altisaur's second ability triggers, and Fall of Cair Andros triggers if the opposing creature's toughness is less than 0.
Resolve the Fall of Cair Andros trigger, if applicable, causing you to put a number of +1/+1 counters on an Army you control equal to the excess damage.
Resolve the Apex Altisaur trigger, causing it to fight the indestructible creature the opponent controls.
Repeat from step 5.

1558-2557-2963-4840.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Teleportation Circle triggers, blinking Myr Battlesphere.
When Myr Battlesphere enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, creating eight 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens due to Parallel Lives.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five Myrs, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2290-2794-4613.notablePrerequisites: Trelasarra has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
2290-2794-4613.description:
Activate Trelasarra using Spike Feeder's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to gain 2 life.
Trelasarra triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself and causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

643-3459-4461-4508.notablePrerequisites: Battered Golem does not have summoning sickness.
643-3459-4461-4508.description:
Activate Battered Golem by paying {R} and tapping it, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
When the Treasure enters the battlefield, Battered Golem triggers, untapping itself.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat.

678-1739-1872.description:
Activate Composite Golem by sacrificing it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
When Composite Golem dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Composite Golem to your hand from your graveyard.
Cast Composite Golem by paying {5}.
Repeat.

2034-3490-4968.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2034-3490-4968.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing any other creature you control, adding {C}{C}.
Deathbringer Thoctar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite +1/+1 counters on Deathbringer Thoctar, you may use them to activate its ability to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

206-404-1521-2105.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
206-404-1521-2105.description:
Declare Flamerush Rider, Combat Celebrant and Ghired as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant, Ghired's second ability and Flamerush Rider trigger.
Resolve the Flamerush Rider trigger, creating a token copy of Combat Celebrant that is tapped and attacking.
Resolve the Ghired trigger, creating a copy of the Combat Celebrant token.
Resolve the Combat Celebrant trigger, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Move to your next combat phase, and declare the Combat Celebrant token created in step 4 and Ghired as attackers, choosing to exert the Combat Celebrant token as it attacks.
Repeat from step 4.
Optionally, you may also attack with Flamerush Rider to get infinite copies of any other attacking creatures you control.
